card.name: Locant numbers before commas in chemical names
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a chemical name that is directly followed by a comma, such as the 3 in 3,4-dihydro or the 2 in 2-amino. It marks a position number in a list of locants.

modes.label: Locant in drug metabolite name
modes.description: The first digit of a numbered position pair in a drug or metabolite name.

modes.label: Locant in other compound names
modes.description: A digit inside a systematic name of a compound, where a comma comes next.

modes.label: Counting list
modes.description: A digit in a plain numbered list such as 1,2,3.

card.writes: It favors a comma next and suppresses commas joined to letters, so it expects the next locant to be a number.
card.plain: It fires on position numbers in chemical names, like the 3 in 3,4-dihydro, just before a comma.
